newsitem.title: UK: UK farmers call on army, schools to promote beef.
newsitem.headline: UK farmers call on army, schools to promote beef.

text.p: Britain's National Farmers Union (NFU) is appealing to the country's schools and the armed forces to reintroduce British beef, following an announcement by restaurant chain McDonald's that it is putting British beef back into its burgers.
The NFU said in a statement that it is asking government departments like the ministry of defence to promote British beef, and wants the education department to help reintroduce it in schools.

NFU President Sir David Naish said Britain had "the strictest controls in the world to ensure our beef is safe and it is time that our European partners acknowledged that". - - Jo Goudie, London Newsroom +44 171 542 7729
